title: Scenario runner: --model / --author-model / --ask-model, with the served model recorded per turn
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ② maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-07), after asking 「你的画廊测试我可以用 workbuddy 或者 codex 测试吗？有没有入口？」, 「你现在本地测试画廊，用的什么模型」 and 「我用 Claude code 云任务可以测试画廊吗？」, then answering the seat's proposals: 「前面的建议都同意，立卡」. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600. Live runs are paused by the maintainer (cloud#3600, 2026-11-07), so verify with the recorded driver and unit tests; no live run is owed.

## Problem

Every recorded turn of the 2026-11-06/07 runs used the login's default model (`claude-opus-5-5`: 17 build turns, 246 persona turns), and nothing lets a run pin or compare models. `ClaudeCodeDriver` already accepts a `model` option and passes `--model` (`driver.ts`), but the CLI does not expose it.

## Ask

1. `--model <alias>` for every turn, plus optional `--author-model` / `--ask-model` to set the build and persona turns apart. Thread them to the driver.
2. The run record and the scorecard state the model actually served per turn. The stream's `meta.model` is already parsed; show any mismatch with the requested model.
3. Tests: the flag reaches the CLI argument list; the record carries the served model.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
